svg.title: Lineage of disaggregated quantization
svg.desc: A vertical timeline: 2018 quantization with distillation; 2023 to 2024 extreme weight-only encodings such as GPTQ, AQLM and QuIP sharp; 2023 FlexGen weight offloading; 2024 to 2025 disaggregated serving that splits prefill and decode across machines; 2025 to 2026 NVFP4 microscaling FP4 and quantization-aware distillation for it; 2025 to 2026 phase-aware precision work; 2026 disaggregated quantization, which joins them.

g.text: Polino et al.: a teacher guides the quantized student
GPTQ, AQLM, QuIP#: 2–3-bit weights for decode
offload weights, amortize loading over big batches
TetriInfer, Mooncake: prefill and decode on separate GPUs
NVFP4 in practice + QAD for NVFP4
4-bit float compute that actually keeps accuracy
formats, weights and storage per phase, trained jointly
